transcript: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Kenji Ford and Elena Kowalski and Kenji Delgado will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Kira Reyes and Ibrahim Costa will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Omar Frost and Deshawn Santos will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

musterRefusals.sayText: ⛔ THE HERALD does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. It notices you the way weather notices a field. You cannot face this alone — sound the call, muster 10 allied blades (you have 0). This is not courage. This is arithmetic.
